verdict.rationale: Postmark publishes a public pricing page (including a machine-readable pricing.txt) that lists some add-on prices, such as DMARC monitoring at $14/month per domain and custom activity retention at $5/month. It also states dedicated IPs are available from 300,000 emails per month and shows plan-level feature differences (5 vs unlimited custom sending domains). However, the evidence shows no per-volume tier prices, no overage rates, no published dedicated-IP price and no email-validation add-on, so a founder could not fully price the service from this evidence alone. Missing for 10: published per-volume tier prices, overage rates, a dollar price for dedicated IPs, any validation add-on pricing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can price the service from the public site alone — per-volume tiers, overage rates, and add-on costs (dedicated IPs, validation) published without a sales call

citations.quote: Custom activity retention | $5/month | Pro plans or higher
